lines.text: He has pushed. He has also pushed.
The crowd is pleased. I am also pleased.
The wiring is the problem. I will fix the wiring.
Zero customers. I am holding up a zero.
Nine. …Nine point five. The line is clean.
The winding is correct. I am John Carter.
I am John Carter. I do not vote on names.
It will turn. I have tested it on nothing. It will turn.
Two taps. No more. It is seated.
I did not programme the salute. Nobody did.
My name is Abbas.
Twenty minutes. The record is two days.
There is also a bucket of earth current.
But that one is heavy.
My name is Abbas.
The robot is fine. It is waiting for him.
My name is Abbas.
Yes. It is called 'Good morning'.
Two thousand turns. I counted. Do not ask again.
Three switches. In order. I am holding the spanner.
Good morning. My name is Abbas.
Sannu. [Hello.] You are here. I am also here.
Yes. It is me. Abbas. Not John Carter.
Hello. I have been holding this spanner since seven. It is fine.
Go. Check your tyres. Everybody forgets the tyres.
Goodbye. Close the workshop door. It does not close. Push it anyway.
Thank you. That is a correct thing you did.
Thanks. I am pleased. This is my pleased face.
Sorry. I measured wrongly. It happens once a year. This was the year.
Your soldering is clean. I would let you near my meter.
Good work. Nine. Nine point five if you sweep up.
You stripped that wire with your teeth. I saw. I will say nothing. I said something.
You are holding the screwdriver like a pen. It is not exam week.
I am walking behind you. At a safe distance. From your driving.
I have waited. I have also waited.
Wrong building. That is Civil. They have more sand. Turn round.
Yes. Tested.
No. I tested it on nothing. It still said no.
Maybe. I need a multimeter.
I do not understand. Explain it like a circuit.
Who? There was nobody there fa. Only the generator.
Correct. Write it on the board.
I do not vote on names. I do not vote on that either.
Why did the fuse leave? It was blown away. …That was the joke. I am done.
Did you switch it off at the mains? Say yes. Then go and check.
We won. I am excited. Inside.
We lost. The wiring was not the problem. This time.
I have been pushed. I am still standing. Noted.
I am on the ground. The ground is level. Good to know.
NEPA. Phase two is gone. The other two are thinking about it.
Light. Do not celebrate. It is listening.
Rain. Do not touch the junction box. Do not touch anything. Go inside.
It is hot. The transformer agrees. It is humming about it.
Suya. Measured portions. I will have two measures.
Bill for the repair. Parts at cost. Labour at… Abbas rate. It is low.
A new fuse set. Thank you. I will name them. No, I will not.
Perfume. For a man who smells of grease. Brave.
A torque wrench. Calibrated. …I am not crying. Bolaji, do not look.
Two thousand turns. I counted. Do not ask again.
Red to red. Black to black. Life is simple. People are not.
At night the cables sing. It is the load. It is not singing.
He pushed. He also pushed. My best commentary. Ever.
Nine. Nine point five. The line was clean. I stand by the score.
You are the fresher who fought Bolaji. He is fine. His pride is resting.
Bolaji calls me John Carter. Every day. Since Year One. My Year One.
The Engineering Garden lights flicker at dusk. Loose neutral. I will check.
You came to the court with flip-flops. Bold. Wrong.
The crowd was pleased. I was also pleased. I said so on the microphone.
The class photo. That gap in the back. Bad framing. Probably.
You took the knock and got up. Correct procedure.
The dam road has no lamps. Somebody should fix that. I am somebody. Later.
Faculty Week. The wiring was the problem. I fixed the wiring.
Iron Mama hums at fifty hertz. Plus a little. I don't like the little.
The winding was correct. I said I am John Carter. I was tired.
Two taps. No more. It was seated. I still dream about the taps.
Zero customers that first morning. I held up a zero. Honest scoring.
Sly's Cuts. I am not a barber. I hold the score cards.
The escalator. Running down at last. You ran down it anyway. Like a hero.
Night shift. If the meter jumps, do not jump with it.
The salute in the exam hall. I did not programme it. Did you?
Strike. No lectures. I am fixing every fan in Giginya. Nineteen down.
Workshop nights. Bolaji does wood. I do wire. Shamsu does talking.
The tower stopped at half. We ran out of wood. Not ideas.
My name is Abbas. I said it in the workshop. Nobody wrote it down.
Your lamp works. I tested it on nothing. Then on darkness. Good.
Strike week twelve. I have rewired the radio twice. Ring Road FM thanks me.
Your phone charger is held together by hope. I can fix hope.
No fan, no light, no exam. The strike is very consistent.
First day at work. Change-Over's office. The record is two days. I did twenty minutes.
There is a bucket of earth current. It is heavy. Nobody believes me.
The robot is fine. It is waiting. Robots are good at waiting. So am I.
Nationals. The robot waited for him. So did we.
You check the earth first now. I taught you that. I am pleased.
Your clip went viral. The fake one. Your dancing was more accurate in the fake.
Walk on the left of the cable trench. The right is lying.
Helen's exercise sheet. Do I fill 'excuses'? I have none. That is an excuse.
Good morning. It is called 'Good morning'. Say it to people. It costs nothing.
Final year. Bolaji is practising my name. I hear him in the shop.
Three switches. In order. I am still holding the spanner. Spiritually.
Two thousand turns on the coil. I counted. I will always have counted.
You don't need my multimeter now. Keep it. I have three.
Defence next week. Your slides have eleven fonts. Engineers use one.
Convocation. Wear the gown. Check the zip. Everybody forgets the zip.
Freshers. Do not plug three kettles into one socket. Giginya remembers.
Exam week. Calculator, two pens, spare battery. I bring three batteries.
Results. A. Also A. Also C. The C is a misprint. I am appealing calmly.
Allowance came. I bought solder. Nobody understands me. The solder does.
Market day. Chi-Tech sells fuses. Half are fuses. Half are optimism.
Final whistle. I am shouting. This is my shout.
Election day. I am counting ballots. I count everything. It is relaxing.
He said Abbas. Out loud. Five years. …I am pleased. This is my pleased face.
The iftar kitchen needs two more sockets. I have brought four. Safety margin.
Christmas break. Campus is quiet. The transformer is not. It never rests.
Valentine. I fixed her generator. That is my rose.
Harmattan. Dust in the switchgear. Blow, don't wipe. Never wipe.
